notes: `upstream` is the Isol8 PAPERCLIP FORK image (ghcr.io/isol8ai/paperclip, built by the fork's own CI from branch isol8/2026.7-circuit-breaker, tag v2026.7-isol8.3 — the 2026.7 line began as a REBASE of our patches onto upstream 2026.7 (936215693); protocol-v4 is now native upstream and was dropped, migration renumbered 0102->0182, recovery-storm throttles come native), pinned by DIGEST. The fork carries our patches in REAL SOURCE — the openclaw-gateway protocol-v4 fix (formerly a runtime sed-overlay in apps/infra/paperclip-extended/Dockerfile), the routine circuit breaker, the agent-delete routines-FK fix (delete assigned routines before the agent so DELETE /api/agents/{id} no longer 500s), honest run-log workspace/session-reset lines for cloud-adapter runs (remote workspace named instead of local-fallback noise), a 400 guard on non-UUID X-Paperclip-Run-Id headers (was an opaque 500), complete child-row cleanup on issue delete (comments/votes/interactions/read-states deleted, cost/finance ledger detached, sub-issues promoted), the agent-comment whitespace fix (openclaw-gateway pickAssistantChunk no longer trims each streamed delta, so agent-posted comments keep their spaces), and the resilient detached agent.wait (the openclaw-gateway adapter polls agent.wait in <=5-min slices and transparently reconnects across AWS API Gateway's hard 2h WS cap, instead of failing a still-executing run at a single 600s wait; bounded by a stall timeout and a 48h ceiling). The extended Dockerfile is now a thin passthrough that re-tags this image into ECR so per-tenant ECS tasks can pull it with execution-role creds (the fork GHCR package is private; the build authenticates with GITHUB_TOKEN and the package grants Isol8AI/isol8 read access). `extendedImage` + per-env `dev.tag`/`prod.tag` are the ECR-published extended image deployed to dev/prod. `upstreamCommit` is the FORK commit (drives the extended tag). Bump `upstream` here to the fork's new digest when shipping fork changes.
